Routine positive diplomacy with Thailand (FTA talks, three cooperation agreements) and the 108 chortens event partly offset the disaster.

en: Glacial lake outburst damages roads, bridge and hot spring
Early warning and vigilance credited with saving lives
Thailand-Bhutan agreements and FTA talks advance cooperation

summary.en: Diplomatic and cultural news dominated: Thailand and Bhutan signed three cooperation deals, and the 108 chorten project advanced. A glacial lake outburst (GLOF) caused flood alerts and damage at Gasa, which offsets the otherwise positive picture.

en: Thailand-Bhutan signing of three cooperation deals
Gasa flash flood from glacial lake outburst
Progress on 108 chortens national project

summary.en: The period was dominated by a positive, well-covered national event: thousands of volunteers built 108 stupas for the Gelephu Mindfulness City, with diplomatic dedications to India's PM and investment outreach from Thailand. A glacial lake outburst flood that washed away roads and bridges is a real but more limited negative.
summary.ja: この期間は、国内で大きく報じられた前向きな出来事が中心でした。数千人のボランティアがゲレフ・マインドフルネス・シティのために108基のストゥーパを建立し、インドのモディ首相への献呈などの外交的な催しや、タイからの投資呼びかけも行われました。氷河湖決壊洪水（GLOF）により道路や橋が流されたことは、現実の出来事ですが、影響はより限定的なマイナス面です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 국내에서 널리 보도된 긍정적인 사건이 중심이었습니다. 수천 명의 자원봉사자들이 겔레푸 마인드풀니스 시티를 위해 108개의 스투파를 건립했으며, 인도 나렌드라 모디 총리에게 봉헌하는 외교적 행사와 태국을 대상으로 한 투자 유치 활동도 있었습니다. 빙하호 범람 홍수(GLOF)로 도로와 다리가 유실된 것은 실제 있었던 부정적 사건이지만 영향은 더 제한적이었습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में मुख्य रूप से एक सकारात्मक और व्यापक रूप से कवर किया गया राष्ट्रीय घटनाक्रम हावी रहा: हज़ारों स्वयंसेवकों ने गेलेफू माइंडफुलनेस सिटी के लिए 108 स्तूप बनाए, भारत के प्रधानमंत्री को समर्पित करने सहित राजनयिक आयोजन हुए, और थाईलैंड से निवेश के लिए संपर्क किया गया। ग्लेशियल झील के फटने से आई बाढ़ ने सड़कें और पुल बहा दिए, जो एक वास्तविक लेकिन अधिक सीमित नकारात्मक घटना है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχήθηκε από ένα θετικό, ευρέως καλυμμένο εθνικό γεγονός: χιλιάδες εθελοντές έχτισαν 108 στούπες για την Πόλη Μηδενικής Μέριμνας Gelephu, με διπλωματικές αφιερώσεις προς τον πρωθυπουργό της Ινδίας και προσέγγιση για επενδύσεις από την Ταϊλάνδη. Μια πλημμύρα από έκρηξη παγετωνικής λίμνης που παρέσυρε δρόμους και γέφυρες αποτελεί πραγματικό αλλά πιο περιορισμένο αρνητικό γεγονός.
summary.it: Il periodo è stato dominato da un evento nazionale positivo e ampiamente riportato: migliaia di volontari hanno costruito 108 stupa per la Gelephu Mindfulness City, con dediche diplomatiche al primo ministro indiano e iniziative di promozione degli investimenti dalla Thailandia. Un'inondazione causata dallo svuotamento di un lago glaciale, che ha spazzato via strade e ponti, rappresenta un aspetto negativo reale ma più limitato.
summary.ru: В данный период доминировало позитивное, широко освещаемое национальное событие: тысячи волонтёров построили 108 ступ для города осознанности Гелепху, при этом состоялись дипломатические посвящения премьер-министру Индии и привлечение инвестиций из Таиланда. Наводнение, вызванное прорывом ледникового озера, которое смыло дороги и мосты, является реальным, но более ограниченным негативным фактором.
summary.ar: هيمن على الفترة حدث وطني إيجابي وحظي بتغطية واسعة: فقد قام آلاف المتطوعين ببناء 108 ستوبا لمدينة غيلفو للوعي الذهني، مع تكريمات دبلوماسية لرئيس وزراء الهند ودعوات استثمارية من تايلاند. ويمثل الفيضان الناتج عن تفريغ بحيرة جليدية، الذي جرف الطرق والجسور، جانبًا سلبيًا حقيقيًا لكنه أكثر محدودية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر یک رویداد ملی مثبت و پوشش گسترده رسانه‌ای قرار داشت: هزاران داوطلب ۱۰۸ استوپا برای شهر ذهن‌آگاهی گلفو ساختند، با تقدیم‌های دیپلماتیک به نخست‌وزیر هند و فراخوان‌های سرمایه‌گذاری از تایلند. سیلاب ناشی از تخلیه دریاچه یخچالی که جاده‌ها و پل‌ها را شست‌وشو داد، یک جنبه منفی واقعی اما محدودتر است.
summary.zh: 该时期的主要新闻是一项积极且广受报道的国家活动：数千名志愿者为格勒普正念城建造了108座佛塔，并有向印度总理致敬的外交仪式以及泰国的投资推介。冰湖溃决洪水冲毁了道路和桥梁，这是一项真实但影响较为有限的负面事件。
summary.tr: Dönem, geniş yer bulan olumlu bir ulusal etkinlik tarafından belirlendi: binlerce gönüllü, Gelephu Farkındalık Şehri için 108 stupa inşa etti; Hindistan Başbakanı'na diplomatik adaklar sunuldu ve Tayland'dan yatırım çağrıları yapıldı. Yolları ve köprüleri süpüren bir buzul gölü taşkını ise gerçek ama daha sınırlı bir olumsuz gelişme oldu.
summary.es: El periodo estuvo dominado por un acontecimiento nacional positivo y con amplia cobertura: miles de voluntarios construyeron 108 estupas para la Ciudad de la Atención Plena de Gelephu, con dedicatorias diplomáticas al primer ministro de la India y un acercamiento a la inversión desde Tailandia. Una inundación por desborde de lago glaciar que arrasó carreteras y puentes constituye un aspecto negativo real, pero más limitado.
summary.fr: La période a été dominée par un événement national positif et largement couvert : des milliers de bénévoles ont construit 108 stoupas pour la Cité de la pleine conscience de Gelephu, avec des dédicaces diplomatiques au Premier ministre indien et des appels aux investissements en provenance de Thaïlande. Une crue due à la vidange d'un lac glaciaire, qui a emporté routes et ponts, constitue un élément négatif réel mais plus limité.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wurde von einem positiven, breit berichteten nationalen Ereignis geprägt: Tausende Freiwillige errichteten 108 Stupas für die Achtsamkeitsstadt Gelephu, mit diplomatischen Widmungen an den indischen Premierminister und Investitionswerbung aus Thailand. Eine Gletscherseeausbruchsflut, die Straßen und Brücken wegspülte, ist ein realer, aber begrenzterer negativer Faktor.
summary.pt: O período foi dominado por um acontecimento nacional positivo e amplamente noticiado: milhares de voluntários construíram 108 estupas para a Cidade da Atenção Plena de Gelephu, com dedicatórias diplomáticas ao primeiro-ministro da Índia e apelos ao investimento vindos da Tailândia. Uma inundação causada pelo transbordamento de um lago glacial, que levou estradas e pontes, é um aspeto negativo real, porém mais limitado.

summary.en: The Russia-Ukraine war continues. Reports say 136 Ukrainian drones were shot down overnight, and attacks on Yandex data centers are disrupting everyday services such as banking and transport. Diplomatic openings, including negotiations with the US and a possible Putin-Trump-Xi meeting, and sanctions exemptions partly offset this, but the war and tense rhetoric keep the score low.

Access to bank accounts and disruptions to taxi services after Ukraine's attack on Yandex data centers
Trump's openness to a possible Putin-Xi trilateral meeting and his postponement of new sanctions
Russia's nuclear and third-world-war rhetoric and tensions toward the United Kingdom
Access problems for a detained Japanese journalist

Hubbard release via talks with Putin, per Trump

summary.en: The period mixes ongoing war news (drone attacks, Russian missile strikes on Kyiv, reported heavy casualties) with signals of renewed willingness for trilateral peace talks and a prisoner release. Drone and missile attacks on Tula and Kyiv continue
Prisoner exchange and extradition from Cambodia

Net, these read as an ordinary-to-slightly-positive day, with GDELT tone more negative than the world average.

Diesel tanker deal with the US and Iran-Russia summit planning

Domestic news is otherwise routine, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

Drone attack on Omsk and Moscow flights disrupted
Reported collapse of secret US-brokered Ukraine talks

summary.en: The period mixes ongoing war damage, including a large drone attack, a rail derailment with burning tank cars, and an attack on a plant in Oryol, with diplomatic signals such as Trump's announced progress on Ukraine and Moscow's readiness to resume trilateral talks after November 4. Domestic news is otherwise routine and the negative tone is somewhat worse than the world average, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

summary.en: The period mixes a reported ceasefire (Kherson direction, a humanitarian pause, and a foreign-reported Ukraine-Russia ceasefire) with continued drone attacks on Moscow, a freight derailment with fire, and regional forest fires. Routine economic, diplomatic and weather news makes this closer to an ordinary day with a mildly negative tilt.

Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow air defences and a jet factory
Freight train derailment with fire in Sverdlovsk region

summary.en: The period is dominated by the ongoing war in Ukraine: Ukrainian strikes on industrial sites, a UN-backed war-crimes finding, and a reported missile launch toward NATO. Offsetting this, there are signs of diplomacy (a Putin invitation to Zelensky for talks and a Russia-Africa summit with trade and training announcements), so the day lands slightly below an ordinary period.

Ukrainian strikes on major steel and chemical plants
UN-backed inquiry finds Russian war crimes in Ukraine

summary.en: The day is dominated by the ongoing war: large-scale drone attacks on the Moscow region, mined evacuation routes near Konstantinovka, and reports of a strained budget and rising fears of escalation with NATO. Offsetting this are routine diplomacy (the Russia-Africa summit) and a firm ruble at month-end.

Reports of a strained budget and new revenue-raising efforts
Fears of Russian sabotage and escalation with NATO

summary.en: The period is dominated by an ongoing war with Ukraine, including a claimed downing of 463 drones and reports of hundreds of drones aimed at Moscow, alongside sharp rhetoric about possible war with Europe. Some diplomatic signals (a reported Ukrainian pause on refinery strikes, African engagement, talk of resuming Ukraine talks) and the closure of the last free newspaper add mixed weight, and GDELT tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

Putin's warnings of readiness for war with Europe and Baltic tensions
Reported Ukrainian pause on refinery strikes and talk of resuming negotiations

summary.en: Routine domestic news dominates, but the period carries ongoing war strain: Ukrainian drone strikes caused deaths and a refinery fire, and missile and drone alerts were issued in several regions. Diplomatic signals are mixed, with a G20 meeting ending without consensus and some bilateral engagement (Kenya, Nigeria, Rubio talks), so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: Ukrainian drone strikes kill two in Bryansk and hit a refinery
Missile and drone alerts across several Russian regions
G20 foreign ministers end without consensus; Lavrov snubbed

summary.en: The period is dominated by Ukrainian drone strikes on Rostov and an industrial site near Moscow, plus a terrorism case, and GDELT tone is notably more negative than the world average. Some diplomatic engagement (the Kenya recruitment agreement, Russia–Africa summit outcomes, Ghana defence talks) offsets this only partly, so the score sits in the serious-problems range.

en: Drone attacks on Rostov region and an industrial site near Moscow
Russia opens terrorism case over Moscow-area attack
Kenya agrees to end recruitment into Russian military

summary.en: The period is mostly routine domestic news, but it includes a cyberattack that sent false nuclear-attack alerts through the emergency ministry app and reports of drone strikes on an oil facility. The localized ceasefire in Kherson ending and a markedly negative news tone add to the strain, though there are no signs of institutional breakdown.
summary.it: Il periodo è caratterizzato per lo più da notizie di cronaca interna di routine, ma include un attacco informatico che ha inviato falsi allarmi di attacco nucleare tramite l'app del ministero per le emergenze, oltre a segnalazioni di attacchi con droni contro un impianto petrolifero. La fine del cessate il fuoco localizzato a Kherson e un tono delle notizie nettamente negativo aumentano la tensione, anche se non ci sono segnali di collasso istituzionale.
summary.ru: Данный период в основном характеризуется обычными внутренними новостями, однако включает кибератаку, в результате которой через приложение министерства по чрезвычайным ситуациям были разосланы ложные предупреждения о ядерной атаке, а также сообщения об ударах беспилотников по нефтяному объекту. Окончание локального перемирия в Херсоне и заметно негативный тон новостей усиливают напряжённость, однако признаков институционального кризиса не наблюдается.
summary.ar: يتألف هذا الفترة في معظمها من أخبار محلية روتينية، لكنها تتضمن هجومًا إلكترونيًا أرسل تحذيرات كاذبة من هجوم نووي عبر تطبيق وزارة الطوارئ، إضافةً إلى تقارير عن ضربات بطائرات مسيّرة استهدفت منشأةً نفطية. ويزيد من التوتر انتهاءُ وقف إطلاق النار المحلي في خيرسون والنبرةُ السلبية الواضحة للأخبار، رغم عدم وجود مؤشرات على انهيار مؤسسي.
summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر شامل اخبار داخلی معمول است، اما حمله سایبری‌ای را دربرمی‌گیرد که از طریق برنامه وزارت امور اضطراری، هشدارهای نادرست حمله هسته‌ای ارسال کرد، و همچنین گزارش‌هایی از حملات پهپادی به یک تأسیسات نفتی. پایان آتش‌بس محلی در خرسون و لحن آشکارا منفی اخبار بر فشارها می‌افزاید، هرچند نشانه‌ای از فروپاشی نهادی دیده نمی‌شود.
summary.zh: 该时期的新闻大多为常规国内新闻，但其中包括一起网络攻击事件，该攻击通过紧急情况部的应用程序发出了虚假的核攻击警报，同时还有关于无人机袭击石油设施的报道。赫尔松地区局部停火结束，新闻基调明显负面，加剧了紧张局势，但目前没有迹象表明机构运作出现崩溃。
summary.tr: Dönem ağırlıklı olarak rutin iç haberlerden oluşuyor; ancak acil durum bakanlığının uygulaması üzerinden sahte nükleer saldırı uyarıları gönderen bir siber saldırı ile bir petrol tesisine yönelik insansız hava aracı saldırısı haberlerini de içeriyor. Herson'daki yerel ateşkesin sona ermesi ve haber tonunun belirgin biçimde olumsuz olması gerilimi artırıyor, ancak kurumsal çöküşe dair bir işaret yok.
summary.es: El período está compuesto en su mayoría por noticias nacionales rutinarias, pero incluye un ciberataque que envió falsas alertas de ataque nuclear a través de la aplicación del ministerio de emergencias, así como informes de ataques con drones contra una instalación petrolera. El fin del alto el fuego localizado en Jersón y un tono informativo marcadamente negativo aumentan la tensión, aunque no hay señales de colapso institucional.
summary.fr: La période est principalement composée d'actualités intérieures courantes, mais elle comprend une cyberattaque ayant envoyé de fausses alertes d'attaque nucléaire via l'application du ministère de la Sécurité civile, ainsi que des informations sur des frappes de drones contre une installation pétrolière. La fin du cessez-le-feu localisé à Kherson et un ton médiatique nettement négatif accentuent les tensions, bien qu'il n'y ait aucun signe d'effondrement institutionnel.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum besteht überwiegend aus routinemäßigen Inlandsnachrichten, umfasst jedoch einen Cyberangriff, der über die App des Katastrophenschutzministeriums falsche Warnungen vor einem Atomangriff verbreitete, sowie Berichte über Drohnenangriffe auf eine Ölanlage. Das Ende der lokalen Waffenruhe in Cherson und ein deutlich negativer Nachrichtenton verstärken die Belastung, doch gibt es keine Anzeichen für einen institutionellen Zusammenbruch.
summary.pt: O período é composto principalmente por notícias internas de rotina, mas inclui um ciberataque que enviou falsos alertas de ataque nuclear por meio do aplicativo do ministério de emergências, além de relatos de ataques com drones contra uma instalação de petróleo. O fim do cessar-fogo localizado em Kherson e um tom noticioso marcadamente negativo aumentam a tensão, embora não haja sinais de colapso institucional.
summary.ja: この期間の報道は大半が国内の日常的なニュースですが、緊急省のアプリを通じて偽の核攻撃警報を送信したサイバー攻撃や、石油施設へのドローン攻撃の報告も含まれています。ヘルソンでの局地的停戦の終了と明らかに否定的な報道の論調も緊張を高めていますが、制度的な崩壊の兆候はありません。
summary.ko: 이 기간의 보도는 대부분 일상적인 국내 뉴스이지만, 비상사태부 앱을 통해 거짓 핵공격 경보를 발송한 사이버 공격과 석유 시설에 대한 드론 공격 보도도 포함되어 있습니다. 헤르손의 국지적 휴전 종료와 뚜렷하게 부정적인 뉴스 어조도 긴장을 더하고 있으나, 제도적 붕괴의 징후는 없습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की खबरें ज़्यादातर नियमित घरेलू समाचार हैं, लेकिन इनमें एक साइबर हमला भी शामिल है जिसने आपातकालीन मंत्रालय के ऐप के ज़रिए झूठे परमाणु हमले के अलर्ट भेजे, और एक तेल सुविधा पर ड्रोन हमलों की रिपोर्टें भी हैं। खेरसॉन में स्थानीय युद्धविराम का समाप्त होना और समाचार का स्वर स्पष्ट रूप से नकारात्मक होना तनाव बढ़ाते हैं, हालांकि संस्थागत विफलता के कोई संकेत नहीं हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος καλύπτεται κυρίως από συνήθη εγχώρια νέα, περιλαμβάνει όμως μια κυberεπίθεση που έστειλε ψευδείς προειδοποιήσεις πυρηνικής επίθεσης μέσω της εφαρμογής του υπουργείου έκτακτης ανάγκης, καθώς και αναφορές για επιθέσεις με drones σε εγκατάσταση πετρελαίου. Η λήξη της τοπικής εκεχειρίας στη Χερσώνα και ο έντονα αρνητικός τόνος των ειδήσεων προσθέτουν πίεση, χωρίς ωστόσο ενδείξεις θεσμικής κατάρρευσης.

Foreign coverage also flags Guterres's warning of escalation risk, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, so the score is moderately positive rather than strongly so.
summary.ja: 国連の西サハラ派遣団（MINURSO）は、ロシアの拒否権行使を受けて終了へと向かっており、モロッコのメディアと当局はこれを自治案にとっての外交的勝利として位置づけている。海外報道はまた、グテーレス事務総長が緊張激化のリスクを警告していることも指摘している。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりネガティブであるため、スコアは強くではなく、中程度にポジティブである。
summary.ko: 유엔 서사하라 평화유지단(MINURSO)은 러시아의 거부권 행사 이후 임무가 종료될 예정이며, 모로코 언론과 당국은 이를 자치안에 대한 외교적 성과로 제시하고 있다. 외국 언론은 또한 구테흐스 사무총장이 긴장 고조 위험을 경고했다는 점을 지적하고 있으며, GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 부정적이어서 점수는 강하게 긍정적이라기보다 중간 정도의 긍정적 수준이다.
summary.hi: पश्चिमी सहारा में संयुक्त राष्ट्र शांति मिशन (MINURSO) रूस के वीटो के बाद समाप्त होने जा रहा है, और मोरक्को के मीडिया तथा अधिकारी इसे स्वायत्तता योजना के लिए एक कूटनीतिक जीत के रूप में पेश कर रहे हैं। विदेशी कवरेज में गुटेरेस की बढ़ते तनाव के जोखिम की चेतावनी को भी रेखांकित किया गया है, और GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर मज़बूत रूप से नहीं, बल्कि मध्यम रूप से सकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η αποστολή ειρηνευτικής δύναμης των Ηνωμένων Εθνών στη Δυτική Σαχάρα (MINURSO) τερματίζεται μετά από βέτο της Ρωσίας, το οποίο τα μαροκινά μέσα ενημέρωσης και οι αξιωματούχοι παρουσιάζουν ως διπλωματική επιτυχία για το σχέδιο αυτονομίας. Η ξένη κάλυψη επισημαίνει επίσης την προειδοποίηση του Γκουτέρες για κίνδυνο κλιμάκωσης, και ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, οπότε η βαθμολογία είναι μετρίως θετική και όχι έντονα θετική.
summary.tr: BM'nin Batı Sahra'daki barış gücü misyonu (MINURSO), Rusya'nın veto kullanmasının ardından sona eriyor; Fas medyası ve yetkilileri bunu özerklik planı için diplomatik bir kazanım olarak sunuyor. Yabancı haberler ayrıca Guterres'in tırmanma riski uyarısına da dikkat çekiyor ve GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından daha olumsuz olduğu için puan güçlü değil, orta düzeyde olumlu.
summary.es: La misión de mantenimiento de la paz de la ONU en el Sáhara Occidental (MINURSO) llega a su fin tras un veto ruso, lo que los medios y funcionarios marroquíes presentan como un logro diplomático para el plan de autonomía. La cobertura extranjera también señala la advertencia de Guterres sobre el riesgo de escalada, y el tono de GDELT es más negativo que el promedio mundial, por lo que la puntuación es moderadamente positiva y no fuertemente positiva.
summary.fr: La mission de maintien de la paix de l'ONU au Sahara occidental (MINURSO) prend fin après un veto russe, que les médias et responsables marocains présentent comme une victoire diplomatique pour le plan d'autonomie. La couverture étrangère signale également la mise en garde de Guterres sur le risque d'escalade, et le ton de GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que le score est modérément positif plutôt que nettement positif.
summary.de: Die UN-Friedensmission in der Westsahara (MINURSO) wird nach einem russischen Veto beendet; marokkanische Medien und Beamte stellen dies als diplomatischen Erfolg für den Autonomieplan dar. Auslandsberichte verweisen zudem auf Guterres' Warnung vor einem Eskalationsrisiko, und der GDELT-Ton ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt, weshalb die Bewertung nur moderat und nicht stark positiv ausfällt.
summary.pt: A missão de manutenção da paz da ONU no Saara Ocidental (MINURSO) está a chegar ao fim após um veto russo, que os meios de comunicação e as autoridades marroquinas apresentam como uma vitória diplomática para o plano de autonomia. A cobertura estrangeira também assinala o aviso de Guterres sobre o risco de escalada, e o tom do GDELT é mais negativo do que a média mundial, pelo que a pontuação é moderadamente positiva e não fortemente positiva.
summary.it: La missione di pace dell'ONU nel Sahara Occidentale (MINURSO) sta per concludersi dopo un veto russo, che i media e i funzionari marocchini presentano come un successo diplomatico per il piano di autonomia. La copertura estera segnala anche l'avvertimento di Guterres sul rischio di escalation, e il tono di GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio è moderatamente positivo piuttosto che nettamente tale.
summary.ru: Миссия ООН по поддержанию мира в Западной Сахаре (МИНУРСО) завершается после вето России, которое марокканские СМИ и официальные лица представляют как дипломатическую победу плана автономии. Зарубежные материалы также отмечают предупреждение Гутерреша о риске эскалации, а тон GDELT более негативен, чем в среднем по миру, поэтому оценка умеренно положительная, а не сильно положительная.
summary.ar: تنتهي بعثة حفظ السلام التابعة للأمم المتحدة في الصحراء الغربية (المينورسو) بعد استخدام روسيا حق النقض، وهو ما تقدمه وسائل الإعلام المغربية والمسؤولون المغاربة على أنه إنجاز دبلوماسي لخطة الحكم الذاتي. وتشير التغطية الأجنبية أيضاً إلى تحذير غوتيريش من مخاطر التصعيد، ونبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية من المتوسط العالمي، لذا فإن الدرجة إيجابية باعتدال لا إيجابية بقوة.

summary.zh: 本时段既有明显的经济挫折，即吴哥的游客人数和收入下降两位数，也有例行的积极事件，如18件被盗高棉文物回归以及偏远地区的免费体检。打击诈骗网络和毒品逮捕人数上升带来一些负面语气，但并无危机，因此评分略低于普通的一天。
summary.tr: Bu dönem, Angkor'a gelen turist sayısında ve gelirlerinde iki haneli bir düşüş gibi dikkat çekici bir ekonomik gerilemeyi, yanı sıra yağmalanmış 18 antika eserin iadesi ve uzak bölgelerde ücretsiz sağlık muayenesi gibi olağan olumlu gelişmeleri bir arada içeriyor. Dolandırıcılık ağlarına yönelik operasyonlar ile artan uyuşturucu tutuklamaları bazı olumsuz bir ton ekliyor, ancak ortada bir kriz bulunmuyor; bu nedenle puan sıradan bir günün biraz altında kalıyor.
summary.es: El periodo combina un retroceso económico notable, una caída de dos dígitos en las llegadas de turistas y los ingresos de Angkor, con noticias positivas rutinarias, como la devolución de 18 antigüedades saqueadas y los exámenes médicos gratuitos en zonas remotas. Las operaciones contra redes de estafas y el aumento de detenciones por drogas aportan un tono algo negativo, pero no hay ninguna crisis, por lo que la puntuación queda ligeramente por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période associe un revers économique notable, une baisse à deux chiffres des arrivées de touristes et des recettes à Angkor, à des nouvelles positives courantes, comme le retour de 18 antiquités pillées et les examens médicaux gratuits dans des zones isolées. Les opérations contre les réseaux d'escroquerie et la hausse des arrestations liées à la drogue ajoutent une tonalité négative, mais il n'y a aucune crise, de sorte que le score se situe légèrement en dessous d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum vereint einen deutlichen wirtschaftlichen Rückschlag, einen zweistelligen Rückgang der Touristenankünfte und Einnahmen in Angkor, mit üblichen positiven Meldungen wie der Rückgabe von 18 geplünderten Antiquitäten und kostenlosen medizinischen Untersuchungen in abgelegenen Gebieten. Razzien gegen Betrugsnetzwerke und steigende Drogenfestnahmen verleihen dem Ganzen einen leicht negativen Unterton, doch es gibt keine Krise, weshalb der Wert etwas unter einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período combina um revés econômico relevante, uma queda de dois dígitos nas chegadas de turistas e na receita em Angkor, com notícias positivas de rotina, como a devolução de 18 antiguidades saqueadas e exames médicos gratuitos em áreas remotas. As operações contra redes de golpes e o aumento das prisões por drogas acrescentam um tom negativo, mas não há crise, por isso a pontuação fica um pouco abaixo de um dia comum.

summary.ru: В этот период доминировали новости об инвестициях и дипломатии: 3,89 млрд долларов в виде Golden Licences, выданных на Gateway Gulf 2026, общий объём сделок SICO на 1,6 млрд долларов, партнёрство с банком, построенным на ИИ, и завершение Manama Dialogue. summary.ar: هيمنت على الفترة أخبار الاستثمار والدبلوماسية: 3.89 مليار دولار من التراخيص الذهبية (Golden Licences) مُنحت في منتدى Gateway Gulf 2026، وإجمالي أعمال بقيمة 1.6 مليار دولار لشركة SICO، وشراكة مع بنك قائم على الذكاء الاصطناعي، واختتام حوار المنامة. نبرة GDELT الأجنبية أكثر سلبية من المعدل المعتاد، لكن العناوين لا تصف أي أزمة وتشير إلى زخم اقتصادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر اخبار سرمایه‌گذاری و دیپلماسی بود: ۳٫۸۹ میلیارد دلار مجوز طلایی (Golden Licences) در نشست Gateway Gulf 2026 اعطا شد، مجموع معاملات شرکت SICO به ۱٫۶ میلیارد دلار رسید، یک همکاری با بانک مبتنی بر هوش مصنوعی انجام شد و نشست گفتگوی منامه به پایان رسید. لحن GDELT خارجی منفی‌تر از میانگین است، اما تیترها هیچ بحرانی را توصیف نمی‌کنند و به پویایی اقتصادی اشاره دارند.
summary.zh: 这一时期的新闻以投资和外交为主：在Gateway Gulf 2026上颁发了38.9亿美元的Golden Licences，SICO业务总额达16亿美元，与一家AI原生银行达成合作，并结束了马纳马对话。外国GDELT语气比平均水平更为负面，但头条并未描述任何危机，且显示出经济增长势头。
summary.ja: この期間は投資と外交のニュースが中心でした。Gateway Gulf 2026 では $3.89 billion 相当の Golden Licences が授与され、SICO の事業総額は $1.6 billion でした。また、AI ネイティブ銀行との提携があり、Manama Dialogue が閉幕しました。外国の GDELT トーンは平均より否定的ですが、見出しは危機を伝えておらず、経済の勢いを示しています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 투자와 외교 뉴스가 주를 이루었습니다. Gateway Gulf 2026에서 $3.89 billion 규모의 Golden Licences가 수여되었고, SICO의 사업 총액은 $1.6 billion이었습니다. 또한 AI 네이티브 은행과의 파트너십이 체결되었고 Manama Dialogue가 폐막했습니다. 외국 GDELT 톤은 평균보다 부정적이지만, 헤드라인은 어떤 위기도 묘사하지 않으며 경제적 모멘텀을 시사합니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में निवेश और कूटनीति की खबरें हावी रहीं। Gateway Gulf 2026 में $3.89 billion के Golden Licences दिए गए, SICO का कुल कारोबार $1.6 billion रहा, एक AI-native bank के साथ साझेदारी हुई, और Manama Dialogue का समापन हुआ। विदेशी GDELT स्वर औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है, लेकिन शीर्षक किसी संकट का वर्णन नहीं करते और आर्थिक गति की ओर इशारा करते हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχήθηκε από ειδήσεις για επενδύσεις και διπλωματία: Golden Licences ύψους $3.89 billion απονεμήθηκαν στο Gateway Gulf 2026, ενώ η συνολική δραστηριότητα της SICO ανήλθε σε $1.6 billion. Υπήρξε επίσης συνεργασία με τράπεζα AI-native και ολοκληρώθηκε το Manama Dialogue. Ο εξωτερικός τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον μέσο όρο, ωστόσο οι τίτλοι δεν περιγράφουν καμία κρίση και δείχνουν οικονομική δυναμική.

summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 사건들로 이루어져 있습니다. 은행 인수 승인, 병원 관련 대상에 대한 USKOK의 부패 수사 압수수색, 인공임신중절 및 장애인 등록 건수의 증가 보도가 있었으며, 유명인 추모와 대규모 축제 소식도 함께 있었습니다. 부정적 어조는 세계 평균보다 높지만 위기나 단속의 징후는 보이지 않아 점수는 중립보다 약간 낮습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य घटनाओं से भरी है: एक बैंक अधिग्रहण को मंज़ूरी, अस्पताल से जुड़े लक्ष्यों पर USKOK का भ्रष्टाचार-विरोधी छापा, तथा गर्भपात और विकलांगता पंजीकरण के बढ़ते आंकड़े, साथ ही मशहूर हस्तियों के शोक और एक बड़े त्योहार की खबरें। नकारात्मक स्वर विश्व औसत से ऊपर है, लेकिन कोई संकट या दमन के संकेत नहीं दिखते, इसलिए स्कोर तटस्थ से थोड़ा नीचे है।

В целом тон немного менее негативен, чем в среднем по миру, поэтому день выглядит близким к обычному.
summary.ar: تجمع هذه الفترة بين أخبار اقتصادية إيجابية، منها تأكيد اكتشاف نفطي جديد لشركة Exxon، وافتتاح جسر بقيمة US$35M، وارتفاع التجارة البريطانية، مع أخبار سلبية مثل انقطاع للكهرباء على مستوى البلاد يُعزى إلى التخريب، وتوقيف قيادات نقابية. وبشكل عام فإن النبرة أقل سلبية قليلاً من المتوسط العالمي، لذا يبدو اليوم قريباً من المعتاد.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از اخبار مثبت اقتصادی است، از جمله تأیید یک کشف نفتی جدید توسط Exxon، افتتاح پلی به ارزش US$35M و افزایش تجارت بریتانیا، و اخبار منفی مانند خاموشی سراسری که به خرابکاری نسبت داده شده و بازداشت رهبران اتحادیه. در مجموع لحن کمی کمتر منفی از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین روز به یک روز عادی نزدیک به نظر می‌رسد.
summary.zh: 这一时期既有积极的经济消息，包括刚刚确认的Exxon石油新发现、价值US$35M的大桥即将通车，以及英国贸易增长；也有负面消息，如全国性停电被归咎于蓄意破坏，以及工会负责人被拘押。总体而言，基调比全球平均水平略微不那么消极，因此当天看起来接近正常。
summary.tr: Dönem, Exxon'un yeni doğrulanan petrol keşfi, 35 milyon ABD dolarlık bir köprünün açılışı ve yükselen İngiltere ticareti gibi olumlu ekonomik haberleri; sabotaja bağlanan ülke genelindeki elektrik kesintisi ve sendika liderlerinin tutuklanması gibi olumsuz gelişmeleri bir arada içeriyor. Genel ton, küresel ortalamaya kıyasla biraz daha az olumsuz; bu nedenle gün olağan bir güne yakın görünüyor.
summary.es: El período combina noticias económicas positivas, como el descubrimiento de petróleo de Exxon recién confirmado, la apertura de un puente de 35 millones de US$ y el aumento del comercio del Reino Unido, con aspectos negativos como un apagón nacional atribuido a un sabotaje y la detención de líderes sindicales. En conjunto, el tono es algo menos negativo que el promedio mundial, por lo que el día parece cercano a lo habitual.
summary.fr: La période mêle des nouvelles économiques positives, dont la confirmation d'une nouvelle découverte pétrolière d'Exxon, l'ouverture d'un pont de 35 millions de dollars US et la hausse des échanges commerciaux du Royaume-Uni, à des éléments négatifs tels qu'une coupure de courant nationale attribuée à un sabotage et le placement en détention de dirigeants syndicaux. Dans l'ensemble, le ton est un peu moins négatif que la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que la journée semble proche de la normale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum vereint positive Wirtschaftsnachrichten, darunter die bestätigte neue Ölentdeckung von Exxon, die Eröffnung einer Brücke für 35 Mio. US-Dollar und steigenden britischen Handel, mit negativen Meldungen wie einem landesweiten Stromausfall, der auf Sabotage zurückgeführt wird, und der Untersuchungshaft von Gewerkschaftsführern. Insgesamt ist der Ton etwas weniger negativ als der globale Durchschnitt, sodass der Tag nahezu gewöhnlich wirkt.
summary.pt: O período mistura notícias econômicas positivas, incluindo a descoberta de petróleo da Exxon recém-confirmada, a inauguração de uma ponte de US$ 35 milhões e o crescimento do comércio do Reino Unido, com aspectos negativos como um apagão nacional atribuído a sabotagem e a prisão preventiva de líderes sindicais. No conjunto, o tom é um pouco menos negativo do que a média global, então o dia parece próximo do normal.

summary.en: There is no clear crisis in Romania in the past 24 hours. A parliamentary confidence vote will be held for the new Niculescu government, signaling a political transition. A low-risk earthquake (M4.8) and security developments, such as Romanian F-16s shooting down two UAVs over the Black Sea, are balanced by a food poisoning incident after a wedding. It was assessed as an ordinary period.

en: Parliamentary confidence vote for the Niculescu government
Romanian F-16s shot down two UAVs over the Black Sea (regional security risk)
M4.8 earthquake, no serious damage reported
Fuel prices fell, with petrol under 10 lei at some stations
Food poisoning of more than 20 people after a wedding at the Brukenthal Palace

summary.en: Parliament approved a new minority government, ending a roughly six-month political crisis, which is a clear stabilising development. This is offset by heightened security concerns, with drone incursions near the Tulcea border, Ro-Alert alerts and NATO reinforcements in the Black Sea region.

en: New government won confidence vote, ending months-long political crisis
Drone incursions and Ro-Alert alerts in Tulcea raise border security concerns
NATO increases Black Sea deployment and troops in Romania and Bulgaria

summary.en: The government crisis ended with Luca Niculescu's new cabinet sworn in and winning confidence, a step toward institutional stability. Security concerns persist after drone debris was found near Sulina, and fiscal and legal issues remain, so the day is broadly ordinary with a slight positive tilt.

en: New government sworn in and won confidence vote, ending the political crisis
Drone debris found in Buzău county; CSAT security meeting held
Fiscal consolidation priority and SAFE motorway contract irregularities reported

summary.en: The day was dominated by violent attacks at schools in Pitești and Bistrița, which prompted an emergency government meeting, and by Russian drone incursions over the Black Sea. A new government formed after a months-long political crisis is a stabilising counterpoint, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Violent attacks at schools in Pitești and Bistrița; government emergency meeting
Romania shot down five Russian drones; Black Sea shipping attacks
New government formed, ending prolonged political crisis

summary.en: Romania's period was dominated by a drone strike that sank a cargo ship off its Black Sea coast, killing one and leaving three missing, with Romania blaming Russia and seeking NATO defence support amid a wider run of ship attacks. Domestic news was otherwise routine (fog, weather, winter prices, a handball win), so the score sits in the serious-concern range rather than lower.

en: Drone strike sinks cargo ship off Romanian coast; one dead, three missing
Romania blames Russia and requests NATO defensive support
Eight ships attacked in 18 days raises Black Sea security concerns

summary.en: The period mixes routine news (Army Day ceremonies, fog warnings, a new government reported after six months of crisis) with serious negatives: a drone strike that sank a cargo ship near Constanța, leaving one dead and three missing, plus a Bucharest building evacuation and a troubled Cernavoda nuclear plant. The drone attack and its casualties outweigh the positive political news, so the score sits below a typical day.

en: Drone strike sinks cargo ship off Constanța; one dead, three missing
Romania blames Russia for the drone attack
New government reported after six months of political crisis

summary.en: The period looks like routine political churn: a government transition to a new cabinet, a court hearing on extending pre-trial detention for Călin Georgescu, and softer demand for state bonds. GDELT tone (-0.12) is milder than the world average, and there is no sign of unrest or institutional breakdown, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day for fiscal strain.

en: Government change to Niculescu cabinet and debt-financing strain
Court hearing on extending Georgescu's pre-trial detention
Weaker appetite for state bonds, per Cotidianul

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with several concerns: Romanian intelligence exposed a Russia-linked sabotage network tied to a fire near a weapons factory, and a water crisis in Prahova is affecting a dam. Institutions appear to be functioning, with courts hearing the coup-attempt case and intelligence publicly attributing the sabotage, and the earthquakes and tax-uncertainty stories appear to involve no major casualties.

en: Russia-linked sabotage network near weapons factory uncovered by intelligence
Prahova water crisis and Paltinu dam repair delays
Two Vrancea earthquakes in under four hours, no casualties reported

summary.en: Romania's period is dominated by a Russian-linked sabotage plot (the Carfil arms factory fire, two arrests in Germany, an ambassador summoned) and a cyber alert that caused public alarm, plus Black Sea shipping attacks that prompted French patrol support. Some mild positives appear, such as a forecast of falling inflation, but security pressure outweighs them.

en: Alleged Russian sabotage network behind Carfil arms factory fire
Romania summons Russian ambassador; NATO patrol support in Black Sea
Cyber alert notifying 17,500 public institutions, causing public panic

summary.en: The day is dominated by Black Sea security concerns: drone attacks, a suspected Russian sabotage plot, and reports that the country's only nuclear plant has not fully resumed operation. Domestic politics and economy coverage is otherwise routine, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Suspected Russian sabotage plot and drone attacks in the Black Sea
Only nuclear plant not yet back in operation after cooling problems
Ongoing political feud over the European Prosecutor's mandate

summary.en: The period looks routine, with a new government formed, a hospital opened, energy and defence deals, and the Colectiv fire anniversary commemorated rather than a new crisis. Negative items include polling gains for opposition parties and a diplomatic spat with Bulgaria, and GDELT tone is close to the world average.

en: New government formed, per Jamestown report
Mazarine Energy deal to buy BSOG; defence contracts with Thales
Colectiv fire 11-year commemoration; ongoing compensation and burn-centre debate

summary.en: The period looks like a routine news day, with positive items (a US official praising Romania's NATO role, SOCAR's 100th station, tourism promotion) balanced against security and social stress (Romania's sabotage accusations against Russia, violence against women, public anger over health contributions). Nothing points to a clear crisis or a clear breakthrough.

en: Romania accuses Russia of Brașov sabotage and Black Sea ship attacks
US official praises Romania's role in NATO
Public anger over health contributions and violence against women coverage

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: severe weather warnings, a few minor earthquakes, road accidents and a drone incursion that prompted fighter scrambles without reported damage. A positive gas-sector project announcement roughly offsets these security and disruption stories, so the day sits near a typical one.

en: Drone incursion over eastern Romania prompted fighter jets and airspace closures
Severe weather warnings for heavy rain, snow and wind
Four consecutive earthquakes reported overnight

summary.en: Romania's period mixes a positive defence step, a historic joint military acquisition with Moldova under the SAFE mechanism, with security tension from massive drone attacks on Ukrainian Danube ports that prompted RO-Alert and F-16 scrambles. Storm warnings and complaints about bank lending add mild strain, but no harm or institutional crisis is reported.
summary.tr: Romanya'nın bu dönemi, SAFE mekanizması kapsamında Moldova ile tarihi bir ortak askeri satın alma olan olumlu bir savunma adımını; Ukrayna'nın Tuna limanlarına yönelik yoğun İHA saldırılarının RO-Alert uyarılarına ve F-16 kalkışlarına yol açtığı güvenlik gerginliğini bir araya getiriyor. Turuncu fırtına uyarıları ve banka kredilendirmesine ilişkin şikayetler hafif bir baskı yaratıyor, ancak herhangi bir zarar ya da kurumsal kriz bildirilmiyor.
summary.es: El periodo de Rumanía combina un avance positivo en defensa, una adquisición militar conjunta histórica con Moldavia en el marco del mecanismo SAFE, con tensión en materia de seguridad por ataques masivos con drones contra puertos ucranianos del Danubio que provocaron alertas RO-Alert y despegues de F-16. Las alertas por tormenta y las quejas sobre los préstamos bancarios añaden una leve presión, pero no se reportan daños ni una crisis institucional.
summary.fr: La période en Roumanie combine une avancée positive en matière de défense, avec un achat militaire conjoint historique avec la Moldavie dans le cadre du mécanisme SAFE, et des tensions sécuritaires liées à des attaques massives de drones contre des ports ukrainiens du Danube, qui ont déclenché des alertes RO-Alert et des décollages de F-16. Les alertes de tempête et les plaintes concernant les prêts bancaires ajoutent une tension modérée, mais aucun dommage ni crise institutionnelle n'est signalé.
summary.de: Die Lage in Rumänien verbindet einen positiven Schritt im Verteidigungsbereich, eine historische gemeinsame militärische Beschaffung mit Moldau im Rahmen des SAFE-Mechanismus, mit Sicherheitsspannungen durch massive Drohnenangriffe auf ukrainische Donauhäfen, die RO-Alert-Warnungen und F-16-Einsätze auslösten. Sturmwarnungen und Beschwerden über Bankkredite sorgen für eine leichte Belastung, doch werden keine Schäden oder institutionelle Krise gemeldet.
summary.pt: O período na Roménia combina um avanço positivo na defesa, uma aquisição militar conjunta histórica com a Moldávia ao abrigo do mecanismo SAFE, com tensão de segurança devido a ataques maciços com drones contra portos ucranianos no Danúbio, que levaram a alertas RO-Alert e descolagens de F-16. Os avisos de tempestade e as queixas sobre os empréstimos bancários acrescentam uma ligeira pressão, mas não há registo de danos nem de crise institucional.
summary.it: Il periodo della Romania unisce un passo positivo in materia di difesa, un storico acquisto militare congiunto con la Moldavia nell'ambito del meccanismo SAFE, a una tensione sul fronte della sicurezza causata da massicci attacchi di droni contro i porti ucraini sul Danubio, che hanno portato all'attivazione di RO-Alert e al decollo di F-16. Allerte meteo e lamentele sui prestiti bancari aggiungono una lieve pressione, ma non sono segnalati danni né crisi istituzionali.
summary.ru: Период в Румынии сочетает позитивный шаг в сфере обороны, историческую совместную военную закупку с Молдовой в рамках механизма SAFE, и напряжённость в сфере безопасности из-за массированных атак беспилотников на украинские порты на Дунае, которые вызвали активацию RO-Alert и подъём истребителей F-16. Штормовые предупреждения и жалобы на банковское кредитование добавляют умеренного напряжения, однако сообщений о пострадавших или институциональном кризисе нет.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة في رومانيا بين خطوة إيجابية في مجال الدفاع، تتمثل في صفقة عسكرية مشتركة تاريخية مع مولدوفا ضمن آلية SAFE، وتوتر أمني ناجم عن هجمات مكثفة بالطائرات المسيّرة على الموانئ الأوكرانية على نهر الدانوب، أدت إلى تفعيل نظام RO-Alert وإقلاع طائرات F-16 المقاتلة. وتضيف تحذيرات العواصف وشكاوى الإقراض المصرفي ضغطًا طفيفًا، إلا أنه لم تُسجَّل أي أضرار أو أزمة مؤسسية.
summary.fa: دوره کنونی رومانی ترکیبی از یک گام مثبت در حوزه دفاع، یعنی خرید نظامی مشترک تاریخی با مولداوی در چارچوب سازوکار SAFE، و تنش امنیتی ناشی از حملات گسترده پهپادی به بنادر اوکراین در رود دانوب است که منجر به فعال‌سازی RO-Alert و پرواز جنگنده‌های F-16 شد. هشدارهای طوفان و شکایات مربوط به وام‌دهی بانکی فشار خفیفی ایجاد می‌کنند، اما هیچ آسیب یا بحران نهادی گزارش نشده است.
summary.zh: 罗马尼亚近期局势既有积极的国防举措，即与摩尔多瓦根据SAFE机制达成的历史性联合军购，也有安全紧张局势，乌克兰多瑙河港口遭大规模无人机袭击，促使RO-Alert启动并出动F-16战机。风暴预警及有关银行贷款的投诉带来轻微压力，但未报告人员伤亡或机构性危机。
summary.ja: ルーマニアの情勢は、前向きな防衛面の動きと安全保障上の緊張が混在している。前向きな動きとは、SAFE制度の下でのモルドバとの歴史的な共同軍事調達である。一方、ウクライナのドナウ川港湾に対する大規模なドローン攻撃により、RO-Alertの発令とF-16の緊急発進が行われた。暴風警報や銀行融資に関する苦情が軽度の緊張要因となっているが、被害や制度的な危機は報告されていない。
summary.ko: 루마니아의 최근 상황은 긍정적인 국방 조치와 안보 긴장이 뒤섞여 있다. 긍정적 조치는 SAFE 메커니즘에 따른 몰도바와의 역사적인 공동 군사 조달이다. 반면 우크라이나 도나우강 항구에 대한 대규모 드론 공격으로 RO-Alert가 발령되고 F-16이 긴급 출격했다. 폭풍 경보와 은행 대출에 대한 불만이 다소 부담을 더하지만, 인명 피해나 제도적 위기는 보고되지 않았다.
summary.hi: रोमानिया की इस अवधि में एक सकारात्मक रक्षा कदम और सुरक्षा तनाव दोनों शामिल हैं। सकारात्मक कदम SAFE तंत्र के तहत मोल्दोवा के साथ ऐतिहासिक संयुक्त सैन्य खरीद है, जबकि यूक्रेनी डेन्यूब बंदरगाहों पर बड़े पैमाने पर ड्रोन हमलों के कारण RO-Alert जारी हुआ और F-16 विमानों को उड़ान भरनी पड़ी। तूफान की चेतावनियाँ और बैंक ऋण को लेकर शिकायतें हल्का दबाव बनाती हैं, लेकिन कोई नुकसान या संस्थागत संकट रिपोर्ट नहीं हुआ है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος στη Ρουμανία συνδυάζει ένα θετικό βήμα στην άμυνα, μια ιστορική κοινή στρατιωτική προμήθεια με τη Μολδαβία μέσω του μηχανισμού SAFE, με ένταση ασφάλειας από μαζικές επιθέσεις drone σε ουκρανικά λιμάνια του Δούναβη, που προκάλεσαν RO-Alert και εκτοξεύσεις F-16. Προειδοποιήσεις για θύελλες και παράπονα για τραπεζικά δάνεια προσθέτουν ήπια πίεση, ωστόσο δεν αναφέρεται καμία ζημία ή θεσμική κρίση.

en: Historic Romania–Moldova defence agreement and first joint SAFE military purchase
Massive drone attacks near Tulcea prompted RO-Alert and F-16 scrambles
Orange storm warnings and cyclone-driven weather across several counties
tr: Romanya–Moldova tarihi savunma anlaşması ve SAFE kapsamında ilk ortak askeri satın alma
Tulcea yakınlarındaki yoğun İHA saldırıları RO-Alert uyarılarına ve F-16 kalkışlarına yol açtı
Birkaç ilçede siklon kaynaklı hava koşulları ve turuncu fırtına uyarıları
es: Acuerdo histórico de defensa entre Rumanía y Moldavia y primera compra militar conjunta SAFE
Ataques masivos con drones cerca de Tulcea provocaron alertas RO-Alert y despegues de F-16

summary.en: The disappearance of four Salvadoran air force members after a gang ambush in Haiti is the main negative development of the period. Otherwise, routine news continues: port traffic, budget and investment stories, and heavy sentences handed to gang members. A survey showing economic hardship and uncertainty over TPS add further pressure, but no serious crisis is evident within the country.

en: Disappearance of four Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti after an ambush, with claims that a gang took them hostage
Economic hardship revealed by the survey and uncertainty over TPS (Temporary Protected Status)
Doubling of container traffic at the Acajutla port, along with border modernization and investment funds
Bukele's security criticisms directed at international organizations and heavy prison sentences for gang members

summary.en: Mostly routine news: positive security polling and court convictions of gang members sit alongside a serious incident in which four Salvadoran soldiers went missing after a gang ambush in Haiti. A swarm of earthquakes in Usulután and an Ebola-related travel restriction add to the strain, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing after gang ambush in Haiti
UN demands release of kidnapped Salvadoran soldiers
Dozens of earthquakes swarm Usulután within hours

summary.en: Four Salvadoran soldiers were kidnapped by gangs in Haiti, and the government launched a military rescue operation while threatening retaliation, dominating coverage. Domestic routine items (a tax amnesty, trade funding, an extended security regime, an insurer rating) are modest offsets, and the news tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers held hostage by gangs in Haiti
Military rescue operation launched in Haiti; Bukele threatens reprisals
Security state-of-exception extended; tax amnesty and trade funds approved

summary.en: The period is dominated by the kidnapping of four Salvadoran soldiers by gangs in Haiti and a special-forces rescue mission, with heavy international coverage and tense rhetoric from the president. This is a serious security episode, partly offset by ECLAC raising its growth forecast to 4.5% and otherwise routine domestic news.

en: Four soldiers kidnapped in Haiti; special forces deployed for rescue
Presidential threats toward Haitian gangs dominate foreign coverage
ECLAC raises El Salvador growth forecast to 4.5%

summary.en: The period is dominated by a foreign-facing crisis: four Salvadoran soldiers reportedly captured or missing after an ambush in Haiti, with special forces deployed to find them. Domestically the news is mostly routine, though rising food prices and a large gang prosecution add some strain.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing or held by gangs in Haiti
Special forces and about 200 troops deployed to Haiti for rescue
Basic food basket at its highest price of 2026

summary.en: The period is dominated by the fallout from an ambush of Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti, with four soldiers still missing and bodies found that the president says are not theirs, plus a UN condemnation. Domestic routine stories, a reported pension payment stoppage and a push for life sentences for Barrio 18 leaders add to a tense but not crisis-level picture.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing after ambush in Haiti
UN condemns attack on Salvadoran military in Haiti
Reported pension payments stopped in October

summary.en: The period mixes routine local crime and traffic news with a tense, unresolved story over four missing Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti, where remains were found but not confirmed. Moody's saying a pension deal eases fiscal pressure and a 10-hour power-cut notice are the main other developments, so the picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: Remains found in Haiti; identity of missing soldiers unconfirmed
Moody's: pension deal eases El Salvador fiscal pressure
10-hour power outages announced for several zones

summary.en: Foreign media report NGO allegations of hundreds of prison deaths under the state of emergency and roughly 93,000 people jailed without warrants, alongside reports of soldiers kidnapped in Haiti. Positive items (housing and road funding, a port export push, an election campaign opening) are routine and do not offset the human-rights crisis.

en: NGO allegations of hundreds of prison deaths under emergency rule
Mass detentions without warrants reported (about 93,000 people)
Soldiers reportedly kidnapped in Haiti during deployment

summary.en: Domestic news is routine, with high reported approval, budget and social-program items, and a minor drowning. The period is dominated by a serious security crisis: about 1,000 troops deployed to Haiti after a gang ambush, with four soldiers missing and a gang leader claiming they are dead.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing in Haiti after gang ambush
Around 1,000 troops deployed to Haiti as reinforcement
Bukele disputes that found bodies belong to missing soldiers

summary.en: The period mixes routine judicial and legislative news, such as housing-credit approvals and Saca's release, with a serious security incident: an ambush in Haiti left four Salvadoran soldiers missing and prompted a large troop deployment. Foreign coverage also reports postponed elections and criticism of Bukele's governance, which weighs the score below an ordinary day.

en: Ambush in Haiti leaves four Salvadoran soldiers missing
Over 2,000 troops deployed to Haiti for rescue
Reported postponement of elections in foreign coverage

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: court convictions, extraditions and tax agreements, alongside a military operation in Haiti and the release of ex-president Saca after a 10-year sentence. Domestic news shows no acute crisis, and the negative GDELT tone is only a secondary signal.

en: Deployment of about 2,000 soldiers and rescue operation in Haiti
Ex-president Saca released after serving 10-year corruption sentence
Tax agreements with Türkiye and UAE to avoid double taxation

summary.en: Routine-to-mildly-positive day: foreign-policy activity dominated by a Haiti troop deployment with reported US backing, plus gang convictions, trade outreach and a new international conference centre groundbreaking. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but the headlines describe no domestic crisis.

en: Troop deployment to Haiti with reported US backing
Mass convictions of gang members with long prison terms
Groundbreaking of Chinese-backed international conference centre

summary.en: The period was dominated by a contested foreign deployment: Salvadoran troops began street patrols in Haiti after four soldiers went missing, and allegations of civilian bombings were denied by Bukele. Domestic news was mostly routine, with gang arrests and a fuel price rise, and tone was more negative than the world average.

en: Salvadoran troops' Haiti deployment, four soldiers missing, civilian bombing allegations denied
Families demanding fair trials and mourning prison deaths
Routine gang arrests and LPG price increase

summary.en: The period is mostly routine cultural and local news, but it is dominated by a Salvadoran military operation in Haiti, with four soldiers reported missing, allegations of civilian bombings that the government denies, and reports of a major offensive against gangs. The Honduras extradition and the domestic festivals are minor positives, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più caratterizzato da notizie culturali e locali di routine, ma è dominato da un'operazione militare salvadoregna ad Haiti, con quattro soldati segnalati come dispersi, accuse di bombardamenti di civili che il governo smentisce e notizie di un'importante offensiva contro le bande. L'estradizione dall'Honduras e le festività nazionali sono aspetti positivi di minore rilievo, quindi il punteggio si colloca in modo moderato al di sotto di una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Данный период в основном состоит из рутинных культурных и местных новостей, но доминируют военная операция сальвадорских войск на Гаити, сообщения о пропаже четырёх солдат, обвинения в бомбардировках гражданского населения, которые правительство отрицает, и сообщения о масштабном наступлении на банды. Экстрадиция из Гондураса и внутренние фестивали являются незначительными позитивными факторами, поэтому оценка умеренно ниже, чем в обычный день.
summary.ar: تتألف هذه الفترة في معظمها من أخبار ثقافية ومحلية روتينية، لكنها تهيمن عليها عملية عسكرية للقوات السلفادورية في هايتي، مع الإبلاغ عن فقدان أربعة جنود، واتهامات بقصف مدنيين تنفيها الحكومة، وتقارير عن هجوم كبير ضد العصابات. وتمثل عملية تسليم المطلوب من هندوراس والمهرجانات المحلية عوامل إيجابية طفيفة، لذا فإن التقييم أدنى بقدر معتدل من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل اخبار فرهنگی و محلی معمول است، اما عملیات نظامی نیروهای السالوادور در هائیتی بر آن مسلط است؛ گزارش‌هایی از ناپدید شدن چهار سرباز، اتهامات مربوط به بمباران غیرنظامیان که دولت آن را رد کرده، و گزارش‌هایی از یک حمله بزرگ علیه باندها وجود دارد. استرداد از هندوراس و جشنواره‌های داخلی عوامل مثبت کم‌اهمیتی هستند، بنابراین امتیاز به‌طور متوسط کمتر از یک روز عادی است.
summary.zh: 该时段主要是例行的文化和地方新闻，但主要内容是萨尔瓦多军队在海地的军事行动，有报道称四名士兵失踪，有指控称平民遭到轰炸（政府否认），并有报道称对帮派发动了大规模进攻。洪都拉斯引渡嫌犯和国内节庆属于次要的积极因素，因此评分略低于普通的一天。
summary.ja: この期間は大部分が日常的な文化・地域ニュースだが、ハイチでのエルサルバドル軍の作戦が中心を占めている。兵士4人が行方不明と報じられ、政府が否定する民間人への爆撃疑惑、そしてギャングに対する大規模攻勢の報道もある。ホンジュラスからの容疑者引き渡しや国内の祭りは小さなプラス要素であり、そのためスコアは通常の一日よりわずかに低い水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 대체로 일상적인 문화 및 지역 뉴스이지만, 아이티에서의 엘살바도르 군 작전이 주된 내용을 차지하고 있다. 군인 4명이 실종된 것으로 보도되었고, 정부가 부인한 민간인 폭격 의혹과 갱단에 대한 대규모 공세 보도도 있다. 온두라스의 용의자 송환과 국내 축제는 사소한 긍정 요인이어서, 점수는 평범한 하루보다 다소 낮은 수준이다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित सांस्कृतिक और स्थानीय समाचारों की है, लेकिन इस पर हैती में अल सल्वाडोर के सैन्य अभियान का वर्चस्व है, जिसमें चार सैनिकों के लापता होने की खबर है, सरकार द्वारा खारिज किए गए नागरिकों पर बमबारी के आरोप हैं, और गिरोहों के खिलाफ एक बड़े हमले की रिपोर्टें हैं। होंडुरास से एक वांछित संदिग्ध का प्रत्यर्पण और घरेलू त्योहार छोटे सकारात्मक पहलू हैं, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा नीचे है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος αποτελείται κυρίως από συνήθη πολιτιστικά και τοπικά νέα, ωστόσο κυριαρχείται από μια στρατιωτική επιχείρηση του Ελ Σαλβαδόρ στην Αϊτή, με αναφορές για τέσσερις αγνοούμενους στρατιώτες, καταγγελίες για βομβαρδισμούς αμάχων που η κυβέρνηση αρνείται και αναφορές για μια μεγάλη επίθεση εναντίον συμμοριών. Η έκδοση του καταζητούμενου από την Ονδούρα και οι εγχώριες γιορτές είναι μικρά θετικά στοιχεία, οπότε η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.tr: Dönemin büyük bölümü rutin kültürel ve yerel haberlerden oluşuyor, ancak Haiti'deki bir Salvador askeri harekâtı ağırlıkta; dört askerin kayıp olduğu bildiriliyor, hükümetin reddettiği sivillerin bombalandığına dair iddialar var ve çetelere yönelik büyük bir saldırıya ilişkin haberler yer alıyor. Honduras'ın aranan bir şüpheliyi El Salvador'a iade etmesi ve yerel festivaller küçük olumlu gelişmeler; bu nedenle skor, sıradan bir günün biraz altında kalıyor.
summary.es: El período está compuesto en su mayoría por noticias culturales y locales de rutina, pero domina una operación militar salvadoreña en Haití, con cuatro soldados reportados como desaparecidos, denuncias de bombardeos contra civiles que el gobierno niega y reportes de una ofensiva importante contra pandillas. La extradición desde Honduras y las festividades nacionales son positivos menores, por lo que la puntuación queda moderadamente por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période est principalement constituée d'actualités culturelles et locales de routine, mais elle est dominée par une opération militaire salvadorienne en Haïti, avec quatre soldats signalés disparus, des allégations de bombardements de civils que le gouvernement dément, et des informations sur une offensive majeure contre les gangs. L'extradition depuis le Honduras et les fêtes nationales constituent des éléments positifs mineurs, de sorte que le score se situe modérément en dessous d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum besteht überwiegend aus routinemäßigen Kultur- und Lokalnachrichten, wird jedoch von einem salvadorianischen Militäreinsatz in Haiti dominiert: Vier Soldaten werden als vermisst gemeldet, es gibt Vorwürfe über Bombardierungen von Zivilisten, die die Regierung bestreitet, sowie Berichte über eine große Offensive gegen Banden. Die Auslieferung eines Verdächtigen aus Honduras und die heimischen Festivals sind geringfügig positive Faktoren, weshalb der Wert moderat unter einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período é composto principalmente por notícias culturais e locais de rotina, mas é dominado por uma operação militar salvadorenha no Haiti, com quatro soldados relatados como desaparecidos, alegações de bombardeios contra civis que o governo nega e relatos de uma grande ofensiva contra gangues. A extradição de Honduras e os festivais nacionais são aspectos positivos menores, por isso a pontuação fica moderadamente abaixo de um dia comum.
